visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of category pill links that filter the cruise blog by topic; the link for the current page is highlighted

contentPattern.structure: One cell holding a bulleted list (or paragraphs) of category links. The link whose path matches the current page gets aria-current="page"

reuseGuidance: Use for a short row of sibling category or section links shown as pills. Not for primary navigation or long link lists.
